main_text.head: Compendiosa ratio discendi Linguam Hebræam.
main_text.p: LInguæ Hebræ lectio incipit à cognitione primorum ejus elementorum, quibus consigna-ta est.
Elementa ista sunt Literæ & Vocales, quarum Nomina, Figura, & Potestas, vel viva voce & scriptura præceptoris, vel ex præceptis Grámaticis cognoscenda.
Literæ אהוי [?] vocali destitutæ, quiescunt, id est, non pronúciantur, unde Quiescentes vocantur.
Literæ בגד כפת [?] ab initio dictionis, & post Scheva quiescens intus notatæ, sine aspiratione pronunciandæ sunt, veluti ב b, פ p.
Unaquæq; litera, non præcedente Scheva, cum puncto intrinse-

page.notes: The Hebrew letter groups in the third and fourth paragraphs are hard to read at this scan resolution; they are marked [?]. The letter after "veluti" is read as פ, with a doubtful final form. The printed sentence continues on the next page. The Google watermark at the lower right is a digitiser mark and is omitted.
